translation.name: A Ch'an Biblia D'a Chuj San Mateo

content: A jun b'it tic sb'itaj yuj vin̈ cuchb'um d'a b'it, yic snaancot Dios tastac tzon̈ ic'ani. Aton jun tic sb'it vin̈aj David.

content.text: Ach in Diosal, ul colineli. Mamin Jehová, cotan̈ elan̈chamel yic tzin a colani.
A eb' snib'an in smilanchamoc, q'uixvocab' el eb', somchajocab' el eb'. A eb' sgana yac'an chucal d'ayin, b'atocab' eb' elelal yuj q'uixvelal.
A eb' tzin b'uchani, aton eb' tz'el stzub' d'ayin, b'atocab' eb' elelal yuj q'uixvelal.
Axo masanil eb' syaq'uem sb'a d'ayach, tzalajocab' sc'ol eb'. A eb' snib'an a colval, yalocab' eb' to te nivan elc'ochi.
A in pax tic jun, ilb'aj in c'ool, cusc'olal vaji. Axo svalani: Ach in Diosal, cotan̈ d'a elan̈chamel yic tzin a colani. A achn̈ej tzin a coltaxoni. Cotan̈ d'a elan̈chamel, Mamin Jehová, xin chi.
